hypothesis_comparison: Theorem1.2 as stated requires a bounded Feshbach map; the source perturbative application uses finite-rank P. Our selected P has infinite rank and its compressed A is unbounded, so that statement is not applied directly. The closed-domain block triangular factorization is derived separately for our bounded off-diagonal coupling and self-adjoint diagonal blocks.
